CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Wired the already-tested level_mod.c into the live game loop: real per-second XP tick (server), real level-up decisions via the real PARENA-compiled function, real HUD readout (client, the exact construct HUD line format). Found and fixed a real 512-byte snapshot buffer overflow bug live (compiler -Warray-bounds caught it). Verified live: a real level-up at exactly 80 cumulative XP. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
